rationale: HASI is trading at 99.4% of its intraday range, essentially at the session high of $40.72, after a 3.41% gap up and 6x relative volume — the easy momentum move has already occurred. Entering long here means chasing at the top of the range with minimal reward-to-risk, while a short against a strong broad market (SPY +1.44%, VIXY -7.12%) and a stock showing persistent buying pressure is equally unattractive. With no news catalyst to explain the move and price already extended well above VWAP ($40.30) and the 9-EMA ($40.50), the asymmetry is poor in both directions.
